meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码缺陷,生成带根因和复现步骤的报告并提交到对应仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的 Codex 插件或 CLI 出了 bug,想规范地反馈给对应的上游仓库
copy.tagline_en: File code defects as sourced GitHub bug issues with repro steps and correct routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hit a bug in a Codex plugin or CLI and need to report it upstream properly

howto.what: 装上后,它会先复现故障,并对照 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码定位根因,再把带环境、复现步骤、根因和修复建议的 issue 提交到对应仓库,最后返回链接。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或排查 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时接管。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 提个 issue,附上复现步骤和根因
say.note: 先复现,再提交到对应仓库并返回链接

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 的问题在干净上游也能复现,帮我提 issue
say.note: 判定归属后路由到 openai/codex

say.text: 已有相同的 open issue,把我的新证据补成评论
say.note: 不重复建 issue,只在该 issue 下加评论

howto.what_en: After install, it reproduces the failure, compares LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources to pin the root cause, then files an issue with environment, repro steps, root cause, and fix guidance in the owning repo, returning the link.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI.

say_en.text: File a LazyCodex issue with repro steps and root cause
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then files to the owning repo

say_en.text: This Codex CLI bug also reproduces in clean upstream, file it
say_en.note: Routes to openai/codex after deciding ownership

say_en.text: A matching open issue exists, add my new evidence as a comment
say_en.note: No duplicate issue, just a comment
